spatial_entity.notes: Old Assyrian kārum and Anatolian royal-city context at Kültepe.

claim.summary: The Kültepe tablets contain repeated documented slave-sale transactions in the Old Assyrian commercial milieu. One specialist publication adds thirteen newly edited documents and draws on ten further documents concerning enslaved persons, supporting repeated rather than isolated attestation.

territorial_practice.notes: P2 reflects repeated transaction evidence at Kanesh/Kültepe; it does not imply that slavery dominated the city economy.

source.title: The Institution of Slavery in Ancient Anatolia in the Light of New Documents
source.independence_notes: Publishes, translates and comments on primary Kültepe tablets and situates them in earlier scholarship.
source.reliability_limitations: Evidence is transaction-heavy and archive-specific; prevalence beyond the documented commercial milieu should not be inferred.

evidence.evidence_role: edited primary transactions plus specialist interpretation

geometry.resolution_method: Representative archaeological-site point for Kanesh/Kültepe; this is a site location, not a territorial boundary.
